x: 12 Ron Hill/Lara Surrey Classic 10 kms, Oxshott: Maria Sharp and Richard Ward made their first appearances in Belgrave colours and both won their respective races.
Although our runners' times (except Maria's) were slower than predictions, due to the strong wind, the team's final position of 11th was 4 places better than predicted.

Enjoying his run on the final stage at the head of the field Steve received the applause of the bedraggled supporters and was even able to question what Maria was on about as she screamed alternately at her man on the road and coach Terry Noad, on the 'phone, back in London.
